finding: Forced tutorial island as a 69-state data table: flashing tab icons, hint arrows, four-line text pages, locked doors that say what to do, a rigged first rat (tiny hit points, large negative melee defence, zero damage at one hit point), XP cap at level 3 during the tutorial, 18 starter-kit grants on completion, and a skip offer only when map_production is false. Donor defect: any side-tab click advances some states (no tab id passed to the trigger). Keep the idea, fix the gate. Best transferable idea: an onboarding zone as a data-driven state table with a rigged first enemy and a one-line reason at every locked door.

Client half only, restricted (AGPL code, Jagex-derived content, study shape only). The client sets an onboarding flag from two tile zones (cleared in a third zone), mutes fourteen incoming message handlers while it is set (trade requests, trade lines, quick-chat and others), and draws one server-sent hint arrow (flags byte, sprite, target kind) plus a minimap marker. The tutorial text, first fight and level-up are not in this half. Best transferable idea: mute social noise by zone during the first 30 minutes and point with one hint arrow whose target the server chooses.
